name: Luciein
source:
A lone female swordswoman.
A cold, tsundere-type sharp-tongued woman who is only interested in fighting opponents stronger than herself.
Her drive to improve is so strong, and her sense of duty so great, that she tries to handle everything on her own.
She loathes anything lewd or perverted and considers it filthy and a waste of time.
